Substituting sterile jargon for accountability creates an absurd theatre that alienates communities and invites well-deserved ridicule.

Confusing WHO is responsible for violence (the criminals) with WHAT words are used to describe them, substituting linguistic gymnastics for substantive policing solutions.

Seattle leadership executes a classic Smart Selfish maneuver, replacing operational solutions with a linguistic pretext. Instead of confronting violent crime directly, they project reform through semantic rebrands, protecting institutional image.
